title: Technical English — Course 3, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 14

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. Why will the demonstration area be closed?
tasks.audioText: The production department has issued a notice that the demonstration area will be closed on Wednesday morning for a scheduled inspection. Students should use the alternative classroom listed on the course noticeboard. The afternoon session will continue as planned. Anyone who needs access to stored project materials should contact the instructor before Tuesday at three.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Where should students find the alternative classroom?
tasks.audioText: The production department has issued a notice that the demonstration area will be closed on Wednesday morning for a scheduled inspection. Students should use the alternative classroom listed on the course noticeboard. The afternoon session will continue as planned. Anyone who needs access to stored project materials should contact the instructor before Tuesday at three.

tasks.prompt: A technical notice should make important information easy to find. It normally states what has changed, when the change applies and who is affected. A clear notice also gives any action that readers need to take and identifies a contact person for questions. Long background explanations can make urgent details difficult to notice, so supporting information should be organised separately. Reading 1. Which information should a technical notice include?
options: The document author, file size and print date
What changed, when it applies, who is affected and what action is needed
The supplier price, delivery date and invoice number
The full history of every earlier revision

tasks.prompt: Why should urgent details be easy to find?
options: So that readers can avoid checking the source
So that readers can understand important information quickly
So that the notice can contain fewer technical details
So that urgent information can be placed at the end

tasks.prompt: Students ___ to use the alternative classroom on Wednesday morning.
Choose TWO features of an effective technical notice.
options: A specific action for affected readers

tasks.prompt: A short official message that gives important information is a ___.
You are writing a notice about a room change. Which sentence is clearest?
options: Something has changed, so go somewhere else.
The Wednesday morning session will take place in Room 14 instead of the demonstration area.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of technical notices in a logical order.
options: Explain the action readers must take
Give the date and people affected
correctOrder: Give the date and people affected
Explain the action readers must take

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words for a technical notice announcing a change of classroom. Include the time, the affected group and the action students should take.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: the notice clearly states the new time, affected group and required student action (0–2); the information is concise, easy to locate and formatted as an appropriate notice (0–2); grammar and sentence structure are clear (0–2); date/time/location vocabulary, spelling and punctuation are accurate (0–2).
